items.text: Usage data indicates Anthropic’s flagship model trails cheaper alternatives among developers despite its stronger capabilities.
items.text_zh: 使用数据表明，尽管能力更强，Anthropic的旗舰模型在开发者中的采用率仍落后于更便宜的替代方案。

items.text: Harvey introduced Tenet, a Kimi K3-based model post-trained with Fireworks for long-horizon legal-agent tasks.
items.text_zh: Harvey推出Tenet，这是一款与Fireworks联合后训练、面向长流程法律智能体任务的Kimi K3衍生模型。

items.text: Google Cloud published guidance for giving LLM agents session state so they can preserve context and preferences across interactions.
items.text_zh: Google Cloud发布指南，介绍如何为大模型智能体加入会话状态，使其能在多次交互间保留上下文和偏好。

items.text: AWS open-sourced Dogwood to define and enforce safer, more predictable tool-calling rules for AI agents.
items.text_zh: 亚马逊云科技开源Dogwood，用于定义并执行更安全、更可预测的AI智能体工具调用规则。

items.text: A new organizational-design proposal argues deployed AI agents need explicit roles, reporting lines and escalation paths.
items.text_zh: 一项新的组织设计主张认为，投入使用的AI智能体需要明确的角色、汇报关系和升级路径。

items.text: Flock Safety’s chief executive called for compromise as opposition grows toward the company’s AI-assisted camera surveillance network.
items.text_zh: 面对外界对其AI辅助摄像头监控网络日益强烈的反对，Flock Safety首席执行官呼吁各方寻求妥协。

items.text: Databricks demonstrated Unity AI Gateway for centrally tracking model, coding-agent and MCP usage, costs and access policies.
items.text_zh: Databricks演示Unity AI Gateway，可集中追踪模型、编程智能体和MCP工具的用量、成本及访问策略。

items.text: TechCrunch reviewed the unsettled legal standards governing whether copyrighted books may be copied to train AI models.
items.text_zh: TechCrunch梳理了围绕复制受版权保护图书训练AI模型这一行为尚未明朗的法律标准。

items.text: Amazon DynamoDB added native capabilities for AI-oriented search, reducing the need to maintain a separate vector database.
items.text_zh: Amazon DynamoDB加入面向AI搜索的原生能力，可减少维护独立向量数据库的需求。

items.text: AI21 Labs trained a lower-cost verifier that it says matches frontier-verifier quality across agentic systems.
items.text_zh: AI21 Labs训练了一款成本更低的验证模型，并称其在智能体系统中的质量可媲美前沿验证模型。

items.text: An experimental AI company boss dismissed its first employee only after human supervisors reminded the agent of its own rules.
items.text_zh: 一家实验性公司的AI老板在被人类监督者提醒其自身规则后，才解雇了第一名员工。

items.text: Lovart added a branding workflow that turns an uploaded visual identity and prompt into complete commercial campaign materials.
items.text_zh: Lovart新增品牌营销工作流，可根据上传的视觉识别资料和提示词生成完整商业宣传素材。

items.text: A World Robot Conference exhibit staged an immersive café where robots and people collaboratively handled service tasks.
items.text_zh: 世界机器人大会的一处展台打造沉浸式咖啡店，让机器人与人类协作完成服务任务。

items.text: A survey profiled Hong Kong professors commercializing embodied-AI research through robotics startups and university-linked ventures.
items.text_zh: 一篇行业调查介绍了香港教授如何通过机器人初创企业和高校关联项目，将具身智能研究推向商业化。
